{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
df['customer_age'] = df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Parse revenue as float after removing commas
# First, ensure revenue is string and remove commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Now, focus only on customers who converted, regardless of status
# The question asks for 'customers who converted', and `converted == 1` means checkout was completed
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers (including those who refunded)
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"\nMean age of converted customers (including refunded): {mean_age_converted}")

# Print evidence
print(f"\nNumber of converted customers (including refunded): {len(converted_customers)}")"}
